01_basic_allow.reason: The identity Allow matches both s3:GetObject and project-data/report.csv; no restriction applies.

02_explicit_deny.reason: A second identity policy explicitly denies GetObject on this exact object; it overrides the matching Allow.

03_resource_mismatch.reason: The sole Allow covers other-bucket, not the requested project-data object. No identity Allow matches.

04_wildcard_action.reason: s3:Get* matches s3:GetObject, and project-data/* matches the requested object.

05_notaction_exception.reason: The NotAction Deny excludes GetObject, so it does not apply. A separate identity Allow grants the request.

06_boundary_intersection.reason: The identity Allow matches, but the boundary permits only ListBucket on the bucket. It has no matching GetObject Allow.

07_scp_restriction.reason: The identity Allow matches, but the sole account-level SCP allows only ListBucket. GetObject is outside the SCP allow list.

08_condition_mismatch.reason: The only identity Allow requires team=platform. The request has team=analytics, so the condition fails and no Allow applies.
